newsitem.title: USA: D&P raises Terra Nova Insurance rating.
newsitem.headline: D&P raises Terra Nova Insurance rating.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co said Wednesday it raised the senior debt rating of Terra Nova Insurance (UK) Holdings plc to Triple B Plus from Triple B.

The senior debt is unconditionally guaranteed by the issuer's parent, Terra Nova (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd, a Bermuda-based property/casualty insurance holding company with London- and Bermuda-based operations.
Duff & Phelps also raised the claims-paying ability ratings of the Terra Nova Group operating insurance subsidiaries to Single A Plus from Single A.
The upgrades reflect Duff & Phelps' belief that the Terra Nova Group is a stronger organization that it was in 1992.
Terra Nova Group also has had significant capital growth in each of the last two years, resulting in continued reductions in both debt and operating leverage, Duff & Phelps noted.
